about: Ajlouny Injury Law works from Court Street in downtown Brooklyn and keeps three further offices, in Garden City, on lower Broadway and in Flushing. It names Paul Ajlouny as an attorney, with Michael Levitz beside him.

360 reviews across the four listings, 276 of them in Brooklyn. Contingency fees, a free consultation, a 24 hour line and hospital visits, published, along with twenty-nine case results of its own. Its site scores 97 out of 100 on mobile, the highest of the new entries after Seitelman.

json_ld_descriptions: Injured in an accident? Our Brooklyn personal injury lawyers at Ajlouny Injury Law combine legal expertise with medical knowledge to fight for maximum compensation. Attorney Paul Ajlouny's background in medicine sets us apart—we understand both the legal and medical complexities of your case. We've recovered over $300 million for clients, including multi-million dollar settlements for car accidents, truck collisions, slip and falls, and workplace injuries. You work directly with experienced attorneys from day one—never handed off to paralegals. No fees unless we win. Free consultations available 24/7. Unhappy with your current lawyer? Get a free second opinion. We handle everything so you can focus on recovery. Serving all NYC boroughs.
